hypothesis: Banning short words at final auction open improves score by allowing a better remaining combination.
reason: Do not treat observed endgame two-letter plays as evidence of midgame waste. Prioritize earlier acquisition and long-word opportunities. A terminal short-word ban lowers the exact feasible total on these fixed inventories.
uncertainty: Retrospective reconstruction of own20smallracks; earlier acquisitions fixed. Does not prove globaloptimalstrategy, allotherterminalracks, or transporttiming reliability.
revisitWhen: A new reproducible case shows an invalid/nonoptimal terminal partition or a changed earlier acquisition policy; do not repeat blanket endgame short bans as an improvement claim.
